# Pinnacle Infotech

> > ISO-certified BIM services provider delivering Building Information Modeling solutions, MEP coordination, clash detection, and digital construction technologies for AEC professionals worldwide.

Pinnacle Infotech specializes in comprehensive BIM consulting and implementation services across multiple verticals including general contractors, fire protection, and building owners. The company leverages industry-standard tools like Revit, Navisworks, and AutoCAD to deliver 3D modeling, shop drawings, scan-to-BIM, and value engineering solutions for construction projects globally, with notable presence in Ireland, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar.

## Key Topics

- Building Information Modeling (BIM)
- MEP Coordination
- Clash Detection & Coordination
- 3D Modeling & Visualization
- Shop Drawings & Fabrication
- Scan-to-BIM & Point Cloud
- Revit & Navisworks
- Construction Technology
- Value Engineering
- BIM Execution Plan (BEP)
- Quantity Takeoff
- 4D/5D BIM Modeling
- Fire Protection Systems
- Digital Twins & Prefabrication
- Seismic & Sustainable Design

## BIM Services by Industry Vertical

- [BIM for General Contractors | BIM Services for General Contractors](https://pinnacleinfotech.com/bim-services-general-contractors): BIM services for general contractors: clash coordination, 4D/5D modeling
- [BIM Services for Owners | Unlocking Value with Pinnacle Infotech](https://pinnacleinfotech.com/verticals/owners): BIM services for building owners using Revit, Navisworks & BIM 360
- [BIM for Fire Protection Contractors | Fire Protection BIM Services](https://pinnacleinfotech.com/verticals/fire-protection-contractors): Fire protection BIM services: sprinkler systems, shop drawings & clash
- [Pioneering BIM Services in Ireland | Pinnacle Infotech](https://pinnacleinfotech.com/services/pioneering-bim-services-in-ireland): BIM consulting & automation services for Ireland construction projects
